10.3 Published Information
Published information contains data defined by the implementer of the BSW Module
that does not change when the module is adapted (i.e. configured) to the actual hard-
ware and software environment. It contains version and manufacturer information.
This is necessary to provide unambiguous version identification for each BSW Module
and enable version cross check as well as basic version retrieval facilities. Thus, the
module compatibility is always visible.

files by defining pre-processor directives (#define) and protect them against multiple
definition. The preprocessor identifier is formed in the following way:
<MIP>_<PI>

module.⌋
